after.zh: 比例接近 1，分类器认的是车；接近 0，它认的是路。训练集里每辆车都停在路上，只看路也能把训练集分对，这种捷径要这样查出来。比例是负数时，车上的格子在给分数扣分。
after.en: Near 1, the classifier recognises the car; near 0, the road. Every car in the training set stood on a road, so looking at the road alone sorts the training set correctly; a shortcut like that is found this way. A negative fraction means the car's cells are pulling the score down.

t.zh: 一张热图要人去看。要是有一千个模型、一万张照片，就得有一个数来回答「它认的是车还是路」。
t.en: A heat map needs a person to look at it. With a thousand models and ten thousand photos, one number has to answer "does it see the car or the road?"

t.zh: 这一关多给一张车的掩膜：车身和车轮上是 1，别处是 0。你要做的：输出分数里有多大比例来自车上。
t.en: This level adds a mask of the car: 1 on the body and wheels, 0 elsewhere. Your task: output what fraction of the score comes from the car.

caption.zh: 第二组：只看路的分类器
caption.en: Set 2: a classifier that looks at the road

brief.zh: 第三个输入是车的掩膜（车上是 1）。输出一个数：分类器的分数里，有多大比例来自车上的格子。
brief.en: The third input is the car's mask (1 on the car). Output one number: what fraction of the classifier's score comes from the cells on the car.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref>算出的平均都差同一个倍数，两个相除，倍数就消掉了。
hint.en: Averages from <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> are all off by the same factor; divide one by another and the factor cancels.
